The '''Ioliu Sea''' was the smallest of the three major bodies of water on the planet [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]].<ref name="cswe">{{CSWECite|II|111|Ioliu Sea}}</ref> It contained nine large islands and was located off the eastern coast of [[Encheeko/Legends|Encheeko]]. One of the islands was named [[Iutuga]].<ref name="SoEPG">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>
